items.question: What additional animal forms are included in this continuing ritual enumeration?
premises: The verse lists items in the accusative case as part of an ongoing enumeration.
The terms vārāhañ, kaurmaṃ, and kṛṣṇa+cchagaṃ denote specific animal forms.
Particles ca, tathā, and eva mark coordination, continuation, and emphasis in the list.
items.inference: The enumeration continues by adding the boar, the tortoise-form, and the black goat to the previously listed items.
uncertainties: The precise ritual function of these enumerated animal forms is not specified within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And likewise the boar, the tortoise-form, and also indeed the black goat.
